text:
Estimate by item, before minus after:
- Vegetables (corn, carrot, broccoli), about 150 g: all eaten, roughly 100 kcal.
- Two small potatoes, about 100 g: both eaten, roughly 80 kcal.
- Roast chicken breast with skin, about 200 g at first: about 70 g left over, so about 130 g eaten at roughly 1.9 kcal/g, giving about 250 kcal.
- Juice, about 250 ml: all drunk, roughly 110 kcal.
- Chocolate bar, about 50 g: eaten, roughly 250 kcal.

That totals about 790 kcal and 680 g.
